metadata.name: Genome Assembly with Pacbio Hifi reads and Trio data for phasing - VGP5 (release v0.9.5)
annotations: Generate phased assembly based on PacBio HiFi reads and parental Illumina data for phasing. Part of the VGP workflow suite, it needs to be run after the Trio k-mer Profiling workflow VGP2. This workflow uses HiFiasm for contigging, and generates assembly statistics, BUSCO reports, Merqury plots, and the genome assembly contigs in fasta and GFA format.
